push.ph.bark.deviceKey: The key shown in the Bark app
push.help.server: Use the public server or your own. Plain http:// only works for localhost or a private network address. It isn't encrypted, and on another network (a café, a hotel) the same address can be someone else's device, so use it only with a server on a network you control.
push.help.ntfy.topic: Subscribe to this topic in the ntfy app, or nothing will arrive. On ntfy.sh anyone who knows the topic can read it, so treat it like a password. Without an access token it needs at least 12 characters.
push.help.ntfy.token: Only needed for a protected topic.
push.help.bark.deviceKey: Open the Bark app and copy the key from the example URL: the part right after the server address.
push.help.serverchan.sendKey: Get it at sct.ftqq.com. The free plan allows 5 messages a day.
push.help.webhook: This address contains a secret: anyone who has it can post to the chat. It is kept in VS Code's secure storage.
push.help.feishu.secret: Only if the bot has signature verification turned on.
push.help.dingtalk.secret: Only if the robot's security setting uses signing (the secret starts with SEC).
push.help.keyword: If the bot's security setting uses custom keywords, enter one of them. It is added to the start of every message.
push.help.telegram.botToken: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste the token it gives you.
push.help.telegram.chatId: Send your bot a message first: a bot can't start a chat on its own.
push.help.dailyMax: Stop pushing to this channel after this many messages in 24 hours. 0 means no limit.
push.err.httpPublic: http:// only works for localhost or a private network address. Use https://.
push.err.host: This isn't the service's own address. It should be on {host}.
push.err.userinfo: Remove the user name and password from the address
push.err.format: This doesn't look right. Check that you copied all of it.
push.err.topicShort: Too easy to guess. Without an access token, use at least {min} characters.
push.err.number: Enter a whole number, 0 or more
push.err.redirect: the server redirected the request. Check the address.
push.msg.needsYou.title: Agent needs you
push.msg.needsYou.body: A chat is waiting for your reply or approval.
push.msg.needsYou.bodyTitle: {title} is waiting for your reply or approval
push.msg.needsYou.bodyAgent: {title} · {agent} is waiting for your reply or approval
push.msg.error.title: Agent stopped with an error
push.msg.error.body: A chat stopped because of an API error.
push.msg.error.bodyTitle: {title} stopped because of an API error
push.msg.error.bodyAgent: {title} · {agent} stopped because of an API error
push.msg.limitHit.title: {provider} usage limit reached
push.msg.limitReset.title: {provider} usage limit has reset
push.msg.limitReset.body: You can pick up where you left off.
push.msg.batch.title: {n} updates from your agents
push.msg.test.title: Test from CYUNEO Agent Monitor
push.msg.test.body: Push notifications work. You'll get a message like this when an agent needs you.
push.event.needsYou: An agent is waiting for you
push.event.error: An agent stops with an API error
push.event.usageHigh: A usage window reaches your alert percentage
push.event.costDaily: Today's cost passes your daily budget
push.event.contextHigh: A chat's context is nearly full
push.ui.pickChannel: Choose where to send push notifications
push.ui.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the saved value
push.ui.privacy: Push is off by default. When you turn it on, Agent Monitor sends a short message to {channel}'s servers: the project folder name and the state (chat titles and subagent names only if you allow them). Prompts, code and costs never leave your computer.
push.ui.saved: {channel} saved. Secrets are kept in VS Code's secure storage.
push.ui.noChannels: No push channel yet. Add one first.
push.ui.capped: {channel} reached its daily limit. Updates are skipped until it frees up.
push.ui.menuTitle: Push notifications · {state} · Channels in use: {n} · Network: {network}
push.ui.pickEvents: Which events should send a push?
push.ui.afterDelay: Only if it is still waiting after {seconds} s
push.ui.testAll: Send a test message to all channels
push.ui.notHere: Not set up on this computer
push.ui.channelPlaceholder: Choose what to do with this channel
push.ui.keepOrClearSecret: Leave empty to keep the saved value, or enter {clear} to remove it
push.ui.savedNtfy: {channel} saved. Subscribe to its topic in the ntfy app, or the pushes won't arrive.
push.ui.testOkNtfy: Test message sent to {channel}. If nothing arrives, check that the ntfy app is subscribed to the topic.
push.ui.onNoChannel: Push is on, but no channel is in use on this computer. Turn one on, or set one up here, from the channel list.
push.net.pausedHint: Push is on, but paused until you allow it
push.net.askDetail: Network access is off, so Agent Monitor makes no network requests. Only push notifications and their test messages use it. You can block it again at any time from this menu or the Command Palette.
push.net.sends: Push notifications send a short message to the servers of {channel}: the project folder name and the state (chat titles and subagent names only if you allow them). Prompts, code and costs never leave your computer.
push.net.test: A test message goes to the servers of {channel}. It contains only a fixed text saying that push notifications work.
push.net.allowed: Network access allowed. Only push notifications use it.
push.net.blocked: Network access blocked. Agent Monitor makes no network requests.
push.net.blockedPaused: Network access blocked. Agent Monitor makes no network requests, and push notifications are paused until you allow it again.
push.log.reason.stale: waited too long in the queue
